topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I mean, imagine finding out something like that, right? I trusted you, thought we were cool, no secrets. But this whole job thing? It’s a big deal, not some small fib. I get it, maybe you felt pressure, or you were scared of what I’d think, but hiding it? It kind of feels like you didn’t think I could handle it or something. We’ve been through a lot, but this is a big one. I need you to level with me, to be real. I think it’s time we talk this out, figure out what’s been going on in your head. I’m here, and I’m listening. Just be honest, okay? I think we can get through this, but we gotta start with the truth.
